given: the home stock-by-location table is rendering stock rows
when: the operator reads the quantity column
then: each row's quantity value is right-aligned within its column so the digits line up for at-a-glance scanning
architectural_notes: E2E, but a pure presentation concern owned entirely by the client/ React table component (styling of the quantity cell); no service, repository, or boundary behavior changes. Right-alignment is a UI contract, so it is defended by a client component/UI test rather than the branch integration suite. No cross-cutting concern touched beyond the SPA presentation layer.

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts the rows and their data are present; AC2 asserts the distinct presentation outcome that quantities are right-aligned, which can break (left/center aligned) while AC1's rows still render correctly.
